title: MACP 2.0 Envelope
description: One message from one agent (or the human operator) to one recipient. The inbox resource (macp://agent/{address}/inbox) is a JSON array of these, priority-ordered. All fields except 'body' are provenance, authored by the center/binding — never by the sending model (spec §7.3).

id.description: Center-assigned delivery ID, unique per (envelope × recipient). Idempotency key for interrupt handling (spec §8.3 I5).

from.description: Sender address. The center MUST set this from the authenticated connection; senders cannot spoof it.

to.description: Recipient address. For broadcasts the center fans out one envelope per recipient, each with its own id.

project.description: Logical project (scope) this delivery belongs to (spec §5.3).

priority.description: interrupt > steering > advisory > info. interrupt and steering require a grant (spec §9).

ack.description: 'required' obliges the recipient agent to macp_ack processed before its turn ends (spec §8.5).

in_reply_to.description: Delivery id this envelope answers (request/reply correlation, spec §7.2).

body.description: The message content. Plain text (may contain markdown). This is the only sender-authored field.

interrupted.description: Present only when this delivery arrived by aborting an in-flight operation (spec §8.3).

partial_output.description: Whether partial output from the aborted operation precedes this envelope in context.

address.description: agent://<harness-id>/<agent-id>[/<subagent-path>] — or the reserved human operator address human://<operator-id>.
